title: Czechoslovak foreign trade: monthly smoothing and trade indicators

methods.label: Observed monthly values
methods.description: Original monthly exports and imports, with indicators calculated from those flows.

methods.label: 3-month trailing average
methods.description: Mean of the current month and preceding two months; complete windows only.

methods.label: 6-month trailing average
methods.description: Mean of the current month and preceding five months; complete windows only.

methods.label: 12-month trailing average
methods.description: Mean of the current month and preceding eleven months; complete windows only. This smooth series lags turning points.

methods.label: Centered 12-month average (2 × 12)
methods.description: Average of two adjacent 12-month means: weights 1/24 at t−6 and t+6, and 1/12 at t−5 through t+5. The first and last six months are unavailable.

methods.label: HP trend (λ = 129,600)
methods.description: Two-sided Hodrick–Prescott trend fitted to monthly flow levels over each complete contiguous sample, using λ = 129,600. At least 24 consecutive observed months are required.

ratio_convention: Smooth exports and imports first, then calculate all indicators; never average monthly ratios.
missing_value_convention: JSON null / CSV blank; no zero-filling or interpolation. Smoothers require common complete export/import support.
display_range_convention: Filter the full available calendar before slicing a display range; zooming does not refit a smoother.
hp_convention: Solve (I + 129600 D'D) tau = y on flow levels; D is the second-difference matrix. Each common complete run requires at least 24 months.
interpretation: Moving averages and HP trends are descriptive smoothers, not seasonally adjusted or constant-price series.
Trailing averages lag turning points. Centered averages use future months and omit six months at each end.
HP is a two-sided full-sample trend; endpoints and abrupt changes require caution.
Smoothing does not harmonize changes in territory, classification, valuation or currency; the supplied series' scope is retained.
A 12-month mean is an average monthly flow. Its export/import ratio equals the ratio of the corresponding 12-month sums.

references.citation: Ravn, M. O., and H. Uhlig. 2002. On Adjusting the Hodrick–Prescott Filter for the Frequency of Observations. Review of Economics and Statistics 84(2): 371–376.
Hyndman and Athanasopoulos, Forecasting: Principles and Practice, moving averages and classical decomposition.
